summary: A menu of actions opened from a trigger: rows with an icon, a label and the keys that do the same, groups under labels, separators, check and radio rows with their marks in a gutter at the start, rows that open a submenu beside them, and destructive rows in the destructive ink. As wide as its widest row; every row a finger tall on a phone.

anatomy.trigger: The control that opens the menu, most often a button or an icon button. Below 768 it takes a finger's hit area, centered on it, and keeps its drawn size.
anatomy.popup: The box under the trigger, 4 away, its start level with the trigger's (align start), padded 4: as wide as its widest row, at least the trigger and 128, at most the window less 32. A menu taller than the room scrolls.
anatomy.item: An action: its icon, its label, and at its end the keys that do the same.
anatomy.checkItem: A row that turns something on or off, or picks one of a group: its check in the gutter at its start while it is on.
anatomy.check: The mark of a check row that is on or of the chosen radio row, 6 from the row's start.
anatomy.gutter: While a menu holds a check or radio row, every other row, label and submenu row steps in 28, so every row's words start at one edge.
anatomy.label: A group's name over its rows, small and muted.
anatomy.separator: A rule between groups, across the menu's full width.
anatomy.shortcut: The keys that do the same at a row's end, small, spaced wide and muted.
anatomy.subTrigger: A row that opens a submenu: a chevron at its end; washed while its submenu is open.
anatomy.submenu: A popup beside its row, at the row's end, its first row level with it; at least 96 wide.

align.does: Where along the trigger the menu lines up: start, or end for a menu at a row's end.

side.does: Which side of the trigger the menu opens on; it moves to the other side when there is no room.

items.does: The rows in order: actions { label, icon?, shortcut?, variant?, disabled?, inset?, onSelect }, labels, separators, check rows { label, checked }, radio groups { value } of radio rows, and submenu rows with their own rows.
items.sokkel-ui: DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuRadioGroup with DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuShortcut, DropdownMenuSub with DropdownMenuSubTrigger and DropdownMenuSubContent

variant.does: An action's look: destructive draws it, and its icon, in the destructive ink.

inset.does: Steps a row or a label in 28, as the gutter does, for a menu that lines its words up by hand.

inGutter.does: The menu holds a check or radio row: every plain row, label and submenu row steps in 28.
inGutter.context: has-[[role=menuitemcheckbox],[role=menuitemradio]] on the popup, reaching every data-menu-row

open.does: Open from the start, as a story shows it.

item.note: 30 tall at every density: 4 over and under a 22 line. A finger tall below 768.

checkItem.note: Pads 28 at its start, where its check stands, and 6 at its end (layout).

shortcut.note: Tracked 0.1em (tracking-widest), which no text role has.

gap.note: Between the trigger and the menu.

minWidth.note: Or the trigger's width, when it is wider.

windowRoom.note: The menu is at most the window's width less this.

gutter.note: A check or radio row's start pad, and every row's while the menu holds one (inGutter), or with inset.

separatorGap.note: Above and below a separator, which runs across the menu's pad to its edges.

submenuGap.note: A submenu stands right at its row's end, 3 above it so its first row is level.

openEase.note: ms the menu fades and zooms in over, as far as motion allows; no motion token yet.

rest.means: A row with nothing over it.

open.reached: a press on the trigger, ArrowDown or ArrowUp on it, Enter or Space on it, or open

highlighted.means: A row under the pointer, or reached by the arrows or by typing.
highlighted.reached: pointer over a row, the arrows, Home, End, a character
highlighted.sokkel-ui: focus: Base UI moves the focus to the highlighted row

destructive.means: A row that destroys something, in the destructive ink.

checked.means: A check row that is on, or the chosen radio row: its check shows.
checked.reached: checked, or the radio group's value

subOpen.means: A submenu row whose submenu is open.
subOpen.reached: a press or the pointer on the row, Enter, Space or ArrowRight on it

disabled.means: A row shown that cannot be chosen.

rest.note: The 1px ring is its edge, outside the box. Under it Tailwind's shadow-md, two layers black at 10 percent (0 4 6 -1, 0 2 4 -2), and shadow-lg under a submenu (0 10 15 -3, 0 4 6 -4); no elevation token.
Its icon in the row's ink.

highlighted.note: Its icon and its keys in accent-foreground too.

rest.note: Drawn only on a check row that is on or the chosen radio row, in the row's ink.

keyboard.does: Opens the menu with its first row highlighted (its last on ArrowUp).
Moves the highlight a row, wrapping at the ends.
Moves the highlight to the first or the last row.
Moves the highlight to the next row whose label starts with what was typed.
Does the highlighted row's action and closes the menu; a check row turns over and a radio row is chosen, the menu staying open; a submenu row opens its submenu.
Opens the submenu, its first row highlighted.
Closes the submenu, the highlight back on its row.
Closes the menu, focus back on the trigger.

appText.rows: Every row's label, the keys a shortcut shows, every group's label, and the trigger's name (an icon trigger's aria-label).

sokkel-ui: Base UI's Menu, fetched after the page is drawn (deferred-menu, menu-engine): until it is here the trigger is a stand-in that looks and reads the same, and a press, ArrowDown or ArrowUp on it opens the menu once it arrives.
The menu is a portal on z-50, and moves to the other side of the trigger when there is no room.
A submenu also opens under a resting pointer.
Focus goes back to the trigger after a keyboard close and nowhere after a pointer close (returnFocusOnKeyboard).
Check and radio rows keep the menu open (Base UI's closeOnClick is off for them); an action closes it.
AccountMenu and NavBar give their menus a border-strong edge and elevation-pop over this popup's look (an open question).
The trigger takes the finger hit area (FINGER_HIT) unless its render element places itself or draws its own ::after (takesFinger).
sokkel-ui-egui: DropdownMenu::new(&items).show(&trigger) returns the index of the action pressed this frame; a MenuItem is an Action, a Label or a Separator.
egui's Popup::menu, closing on a click outside; end() lines the menu's end up with the trigger's.
MenuItem's tint, hint, id and keywords serve the command palette and the board: an icon in a color of its own, a muted word at the row's end.

As of 26b411f, DropdownMenu draws actions 30 tall, 6 in, with a 16 icon and 22 to the label, keys or a hint at the end, labels in text.badge, separators, destructive and disabled rows, the accent highlight under the pointer, and start or end alignment. Not yet: check and radio rows, the gutter, inset, submenus, side, finger-tall rows below 768, the trigger's finger hit area, and the keys (opening from the keyboard, the arrows wrapping, Home, End, typing, Enter, Space, ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Escape).
